questions.question: State the expansion of PCI and mention its use in a computer system.
questions.solution_html:
• Expansion of PCI and its use in a computer system.
  • ● PCI = Peripheral Component Interconnect.
  • ● Used as a bus/slot on the motherboard to plug in expansion cards (network card, sound
  • card, graphics card, etc.).
  • Marking
  • ● (1 mark) – Correct expansion “Peripheral Component Interconnect” (or close spelling).
  • ● (1 mark) – Any correct use like: “to add extra cards,” “to connect devices like sound or
  • LAN card,” “used for expansion slots.”
  • Definition: group of memory chips/modules or slots ((2 marks)).
  • Definition: devices connected to computer externally.
  • Definition of error codes ((2 marks)).
  • Full backup – all data (pros: simple; cons: time, space).
  • Definition: programs/devices that check hardware health.
  • High‑end CPU/GPU generate a lot of heat.
  • Power off/unplug for safety.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Name the device used to measure electrical current and mention one additional measurement it can perform.
questions.solution_html:
• Device used to measure electrical current and one additional measurement.
  • ● Ammeter or Multimeter.
  • ● Additional: voltage, resistance, continuity, etc.
  • Marking
  • ● (1 mark) – “Multimeter” or “Ammeter” (accept “tester” if context clearly electrical).
  • ● (1 mark) – Any other valid quantity: voltage, resistance, continuity, etc.
  • ● If they write “voltmeter” but say “measures current and voltage,” give at least (1 mark)
  • (liberal).
  • Helps in organizing RAM installation ((1 mark)).
  • Input: allow users to give commands/data.
  • Indicate specific faulty hardware area.
  • Incremental – only changed since last backup of any type.
  • They test components like RAM, HDD, CPU temperatures.
  • Heat affects performance (slow down freezing).
  • Use soft brush/compressed air.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: State the expansion of BIOS and mention its use in a computer system.
questions.solution_html:
• Expansion of BIOS and its use.
  • ● BIOS = Basic Input/Output System.
  • ● Firmware that starts the computer, performs POST, and helps load the OS.
  • Marking
  • ● (1 mark) – Correct expansion.
  • ● (1 mark) – Any reasonable use: “helps to start computer,” “checks hardware at startup,”
  • “loads OS,” etc.
  • Allows expansion of RAM ((1 mark)).
  • Output: show results (monitor, printer).
  • Reduce time for troubleshooting.
  • Differential – changed since last full backup.
  • Help identify exact cause of problem.
  • Risk of permanent damage if overheated.
  • Use mild cleaning liquid, not directly on keyboard.
questions.final_answer: Use mild cleaning liquid, not directly on keyboard
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define a USB port.
questions.solution_html:
• ● A standard interface/port used to connect peripherals (mouse, keyboard, pen drive, etc.)
  • and transfer data/power.
  • Marking
  • ● (2 marks) – Mentions “type of port/connector” + “used to connect devices like pen drive
  • keyboard, etc.”
  • ● (1 mark) – Says “place where we insert pen drive” or “port to plug devices” without “data
  • transfer” idea.
  • Supports speed/performance by matching system architecture ((1 mark)).
  • Storage: additional space, portability (USB drives).
  • Need for backup strategies – protection against hardware failure, malware, loss.
  • Reduce guesswork and save time.
  • Need for better cooling designs (fans, airflow, liquid).
  • Avoid water strong chemicals entering keys.
questions.final_answer: Avoid water strong chemicals entering keys
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Differentiate between remote troubleshooting and on-site troubleshooting.
questions.solution_html:
• ● Remote: problem solved using internet/phone, no physical presence.
  • ● On‑site: technician physically at the computer location.
  • Marking
  • ● (1 mark) – Explains remote (online from different place).
  • ● (1 mark) – Explains on-site (physically visiting).
  • Communication: network devices (NIC, modem).
  • Example: beep codes during POST.
  • At least one example (e.g., daily incremental + weekly full).
  • Examples: memory test utilities, HDD SMART tools, etc.
  • Example: gaming PCs, servers.
  • Reconnect only when dry.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe the basic troubleshooting methods to solve keyboard or mouse errors.Describe the basic troubleshooting methods to solve keyboard or mouse errors.
questions.solution_html:
• Basic troubleshooting methods for keyboard or mouse errors.
  • ● Check cable/USB connection.
  • ● Try different USB port.
  • ● Restart system.
  • ● Check if device is enabled in OS drivers installed.
  • ● Clean dirt/dust from mouse sensor/keys.
  • ● Test with another keyboard/mouse.
  • Marking
  • ● (2 marks) – Any two sensible steps listed.
  • ● (1 mark) – Only one valid troubleshooting step.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define a malware signature.
questions.solution_html:
• ● A unique pattern or identifier used by antivirus to detect specific
  • malware.
  • Marking
  • ● (2 marks) – Mentions “unique pattern/identifier” + “used by antivirus to find virus/malware.”
  • ● (1 mark) – Just says “a code or pattern of virus” without linking to detection.
questions.final_answer: ● – Just says “a code or pattern of virus” without linking to detection

questions.question: Define expansion cards.
questions.solution_html:
• ● Circuit boards inserted into expansion slots (like PCI) to add extra functions: sound
  • network, video, etc.
  • Marking
  • ● (2 marks) – Any description like “extra card plugged into motherboard to add functions”
  • (sound card, graphics).
  • ● (1 mark) – “Hardware added to increase capacity” with no mention of slot or card.
questions.final_answer: ● – “Hardware added to increase capacity” with no mention of slot or card

questions.question: List any two preventive maintenance activities for computers.
questions.solution_html:
• List any two preventive maintenance activities for computers.
  • ● Regular cleaning (dust removal).
  • ● Checking and securing cables.
  • ● Updating antivirus OS.
  • ● Regular backups.
  • ● Proper ventilation/cooling checks.
  • Marking
  • ● (2 marks) – Any two relevant activities.
  • ● (1 mark) – Only one correct.

questions.question: Define a memory bank and explain its significance in memory organization.
questions.solution_html:
• Memory bank and its significance.
  • ● Memory bank: a group of memory slots or modules treated as a unit (on motherboard).
  • ● Used to install RAM modules in matched groups.
  • ● Significance: expands memory, matches bus width, improves performance.
  • Expected points

questions.question: Explain the necessity of peripheral devices.
questions.solution_html:
• Necessity of peripheral devices.
  • ● Peripherals are needed for
  • ○ Input (keyboard/mouse).
  • ○ Output (monitor/printer).
  • ○ Storage (external drives).
  • ● Without peripherals, user cannot interact with or see results from the system.
  • Expected points (any 4–5)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Distinguish between the functions of a mouse and a joystick with suitable examples.
questions.solution_html:
• Core differences (IT Essentials style)
  • ● Mouse
  • ○ Used for pointer control on screen (desktop work).
  • ○ Movement mostly 2D on a surface.
  • ● Joystick
  • ○ Used for games/simulations.
  • ○ More 3D movement control (direction, angle).
  • ● Buttons/usage examples.
  • Marking
  • ● (2 marks) – Correct description of mouse.
  • ● (2 marks) – Correct description of joystick.
  • ● (1 mark) – At least one clear functional difference or example.
questions.final_answer: ● – At least one clear functional difference or example
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Examine the role of error codes in diagnosing hardware failures
questions.solution_html:
• Role of error codes in diagnosing hardware failures.
  • ● Error codes (beep codes, POST codes, numeric codes, LEDs) indicate where problem
  • lies (RAM, video, CPU).
  • ● Save time and effort in diagnosis.
  • ● Help technicians follow correct troubleshooting path.
  • ● Reduce trial‑and‑error replacement.
  • Expected points

questions.solution_html:

  • ● Hardware diagnostics (memory test, HDD test).
  • ● Software utilities (built‑in OS tools, third-party tools).

questions.question: Explain why high-performance computers require advanced cooling systems.
questions.solution_html:
• [U ]
  • ● High‑performance components consume more power → more heat.
  • ● Excess heat causes throttling, errors, and damage.
  • ● Advanced cooling (heat sinks, multiple fans, liquid cooling) needed to keep temperatures
  • safe.
  • Expected points

questions.question: Mention the guidelines to be followed during keyboard cleaning.
questions.solution_html:
• Guidelines to be followed during keyboard cleaning.
  • ● Turn off/unplug computer before cleaning.
  • ● Remove loose dust using compressed air or brush.
  • ● Use slightly damp (not wet) cloth; avoid liquid inside.
  • ● Do not use harsh chemicals.
  • ● Ensure everything is dry before reconnecting.
  • Expected points
